title: Simple normal-crossing boundary of normalized Chow quotients of convex Picard-one varieties
author: Gianluca Occhetta; Luis E. Solá Conde
work: Chow quotients of C*-actions on convex varieties
source_version: arXiv:2503.19663v4 (2026-09-16 06:25:14 UTC); EpiGA 10 (2026), Article 16, formal publication 2026-09-18
difficulty_reason: The proof must do more than establish smoothness of a previously constructed quotient. It passes from embedded Hilbert deformations to all node-smoothing directions through a conormal Ext sequence, uses torus weight-zero surjectivity to remain in the Chow quotient, obtains independent local discriminant equations, and globally identifies their branches with exactly r−1 irreducible boundary divisors indexed by inner fixed components. This combined deformation-theoretic and global-geometric obligation is a concrete H2 core beyond routine qualifying algebraic geometry. The earlier smoothness and blowup statements do not themselves give the new SNC boundary description. H3 is not asserted.
